body:
## Correction: the settings UI already exists — it's just not wired up

After more digging, the framework **already has** a UI-editable Branding settings page; there is no need to invent a new `sys_settings` object. The missing piece is purely **consumer wiring**.

### What already exists
`service-settings` ships a Branding manifest — `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/branding.manifest.ts`:

- Namespace `branding`, `scope: 'tenant'`, gated by `setup.access` / `setup.write`
- Field **`workspace_name`** (label "Workspace name", default `ObjectStack`, 1–60 chars) — plus `support_email`, `theme_mode`, `accent_color`, `logo_url`
- Editable in the UI at `…/_console/apps/setup/system/settings/branding` and persisted via the settings service

### The actual gap
**Nothing consumes `branding.workspace_name`.** A repo-wide search finds zero runtime readers — the value is stored but never used. So today, changing "Workspace name" in the UI renames nothing.

- Auth email `appName` still resolves from config/env only — `auth-manager.ts:1105` → `this.config.appName ?? 'ObjectStack'`
- HTML titles are still hardcoded (`apps/account/index.html:10`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:1402`)

### Revised proposal
Wire the existing `branding.workspace_name` setting into the brand surfaces, with this resolution order:

```
branding.workspace_name (tenant setting, UI-editable)
  ?? OS_APP_NAME (env)
  ?? built-in default
```

- [ ] Auth email `appName` resolves from the branding setting (env as fallback). Needs runtime resolution at send-time + caching, since the setting is tenant-scoped and the value is currently read once at plugin construction.
- [ ] `apps/account` HTML title
- [ ] REST docs title (`rest-server.ts`)
- [ ] Align the default — manifest defaults to `ObjectStack`, auth defaults to `ObjectStack`, but `apps/account/index.html` says `ObjectOS Account`. Pick one canonical default.

### Acceptance criteria
- Setting **Workspace name** in the Branding UI renames auth emails, the account SPA title, and the API docs title — no redeploy required.
- `OS_APP_NAME` still works as the boot-time fallback when the setting is unset.

(Context: in the `cloud` repo we wired `OS_APP_NAME` → auth `appName` (default `ObjectOS Cloud`) as the fallback layer. The UI-driven layer is this framework-side wiring.)

The core wiring — auth email `{{appName}}` ← `branding.workspace_name` — is up in #1450.

- Binds on `kernel:ready` + re-applies on `settings:changed` (mirrors EmailServicePlugin).
- Only an explicitly-set value overrides; manifest `default` falls through to the configured `appName`, so `OS_APP_NAME` still wins when the setting is untouched.
- 3 new tests, 21/21 passing.

Still open from this issue (left as a focused follow-up — separate layers):
- [ ] `apps/account/index.html` `<title>` (client-side `document.title` on boot)
- [ ] `rest-server.ts` `/docs` `<title>` (thread settings into `RestServer`)
- [ ] reconcile conflicting defaults (`ObjectStack` vs `ObjectOS Account`)
